title: feat(connectNumericMenu): update state lifecycle
body:
This PR updates the `getWidgetState`/`getWidgetSearchParameters` in `connectNumericMenu`.

The `getWidgetState` function is simplified, we don't preserve the reference equality anymore. We perform a deep inside the `RoutingManager` anyway. Agree that with with a reference check it would be faster, but for 99% of cases the `uiState` will actually change. It means that even with the ref check will go through the deep equal comparison. I've also removed the snapshots.

The `getWidgetSearchParamters` function adds default value when the `uiState` is empty. We don't apply the previous value on purpose, the `uiState` drives completely the `SearchParameters`.

I've not removed the `getConfiguration` lifecycle (yet) to avoid breaking everything. Once we've made the switch to `getWidgetSearchParameters` we'll remove them.
